syn-001.summary: A synthetic experiment compares an autoplay feed with a feed that pauses after each clip. People in the autoplay feed watched longer and felt less in control. The authors link this to the lack of a stopping cue.

keywords.quote: Participants in the autoplay condition watched for longer and reported less sense of control.
The absence of a stopping cue meant that sessions ended only when an external interruption occurred.

syn-002.summary: A synthetic interview study on stories that vanish after 24 hours. Interviewees checked the app often so they would not miss posts. The authors propose ephemeral content as a separate addictive pattern.
syn-002.new_category_definition: Content that is only available for a short, fixed time, so users check often to avoid missing it.

keywords.quote: We describe ephemeral content as posts that are only available for a short, fixed period.
Disappearing stories were mentioned by most interviewees as the main reason for frequent checking.

syn-008.summary: A synthetic analysis of streak mechanics in language learning apps. When a streak was about to break, the apps offered a paid repair, and users with long streaks paid more often. The authors relate this to loss aversion.

keywords.quote: Users who bought a streak repair opened the app twice as often.
We relate these findings to loss aversion.

syn-011.summary: A synthetic experiment shows temporary posts with and without a countdown timer. Participants who saw the timer came back sooner. The authors suggest visible time limits increase the pressure to return.

keywords.quote: In one version a countdown timer shows how long each post will remain visible.

syn-012.summary: A synthetic survey of players about spending in mobile games. Loot boxes are often sold for a premium currency, and players could not say what they had spent in real money. The authors argue currency conversion hides the price of random rewards.

keywords.quote: Many games sell loot boxes for a premium currency rather than for money.
Players often could not say how much real money a loot box had cost them.
